n22.why: F9d-f are FE current-density maps with current arrows running from the worn track to the unworn surface and F6d pairs FE current with wear volume; the reader lacked the caption and took them for melt-pool flow, and the anode/cathode reading is already declared as text in requires_unseen.

o27.why: The panels show the hot spot at the worn-track edge, arrows reaching the unworn side and the strongest field in Al/Mg (e); the reader misread the quantity as temperature because it had no caption.

o5.why: F1c shows a dominant (111)/(0002) peak near 38.5 deg in the Al/Ti trace, (111) near 43 deg in Cu and a broad (10-11) near 36 deg in Mg; the reader just listed the minor peaks as well.
